title: DARPA robot mission to search Tora Bora caves for Bin Laden
place_text: Tora Bora and Bagram Airfield, Afghanistan

tellings.quote: I was I had a by name request uhhuh from my former boss uh jumo Brown

plain: In 2001 and 2002, a team from DARPA, the Pentagon's agency for advanced research, is said to have sent robots into the caves of Tora Bora in Afghanistan to search for Osama bin Laden, working out of Bagram Airfield. John Blitch, who says he took part, explains that he went because his former boss, a man named Jumo Brown, asked for him by name, and he names others involved, including Allan Mack and Tim Gallaudet. Blitch, who in the same conversation says he was abducted by an alien, tells it to show the kind of secret military work he did.
